title: MC Dungeons: Remastered
description: A Modpack with every Minecraft Dungeons feature you could imagine (DLCs Included(
body:
**What is Dungeons: Reforged?**

Using under 100 mods, this modpack simulates the original Minecraft Dungeons game, compelete with all of its features, all DLCs, and all of its adventures.

What's more is that this modpack expands upon the original title using mods that feature so much content they could be fullblown DLCs, **things like a fully-fledged Magic system, Several new bosses to battle, many new High quality illager mobs, and more!**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gMpbbqvteKo&t=236s<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/gMpbbqvteKo" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**Does this replace the original game?** 

Absolutely not, the original game is a masterpiece, a one of a kind experience, never miss it out! I recommend you play the game first, then try this modpack for similar, but expanded feel.
